Description.Name: Gerrida
Description.Details: The Gerrida is a Society super-heavy hovertank designed as a fast skirmisher capable of identifying and overwhelming weak points in enemy formations. Its distinctive radial layout, articulated hover pads, and flotation hull allow it to operate effectively across difficult terrain and water, while an XXL engine provides exceptional mobility for a vehicle of its size. Designed with vehicular jump jets in mind, the Gerrida combines unusual maneuverability with heavy protection, though its advanced construction limits deployment primarily to elite Society vehicle crews. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Vehicle Adv. Stealth Structure: Vehicle Composite Values A S Front 220 70 Left 200 70 Right 200 70 Rear 150 70 Turret 200 70 Total 970 350 Quirk: Distracting Omni Vehicle

YangsThoughts: Now this one’s a long-range killer. That HAG/30 can hammer anything it can see—or fill the sky with flak if something decides to fly too close—while the ER Large Laser gives it some extra reach without burning ammo. Throw in the Light Active Probe, and the Gerrida can find the weak spots before it starts punching holes in them.
